text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Trainer, are you feeling a little
tired?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Lemme share some of these

rejuvenation items I have.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Aroma oil... herbal tea... and bath
bombs... Hehe,
I know, I've got all sorts
of good stuff. ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's important to have little daily
relaxation! Work
and studying can really
take it out of you, after
all.
